video_title: Sidy Cissoko Media Availability | Oct. 5, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.speaker: Sidy Cissoko
quotes.summary_phrase: Sidy Cissoko on maintaining his professional mindset and work ethic
quotes.excerpt: Each game is an opportunity to showcase yourself. Day by day, that's my work.
quotes.quote: I'm still serious. That's always how I'll be playing. I play every time like it's the last game in practice too. Each game is an opportunity to showcase yourself. Day by day, that's my work and I got to show it to work and do a good job every day.
quotes.social_post: Sidy Cissoko says he is maintaining his professional approach in practice, noting that he plays every session like it is his last game to showcase his skills.

quotes.speaker: Sidy Cissoko
quotes.summary_phrase: Sidy Cissoko on balancing physical defense with teammate safety
quotes.excerpt: I don't want to be so much aggressive and people get hurt. We trying to save our teammates.
quotes.quote: Most of the time we be on the same team. I'm starting to take it easy because I don't want to be so much aggressive and people get hurt. We trying to save our teammates. We going to see the first game against Golden State, now is the time to showcase ourself and just really be physical with the other guys on other teams.
quotes.social_post: Sidy Cissoko says he is dialing back his aggression in practice to avoid hurting teammates, but plans to be physical once the Blazers face other teams.

quotes.speaker: Sidy Cissoko
quotes.summary_phrase: Sidy Cissoko on his offseason shooting development
quotes.excerpt: I'm getting better, I'm still young. I have time to develop.
quotes.quote: I think the same thing. Trust the coaching staff, trust the work. I know him since my pre-draft and he's been doing a great job in summertime. I want to shout out him, Gilbert Abraham, and JT too. I'm getting better, I'm still young. I have time to develop. Shooting-wise, I think it's more confidence because I think all the NBA players can shoot.
quotes.social_post: Sidy Cissoko credits his offseason shooting development to the coaching staff, adding that he believes shooting in the NBA is mostly about confidence.

quotes.speaker: Sidy Cissoko
quotes.summary_phrase: Sidy Cissoko on the development and impact of Donovan Clingan
quotes.excerpt: He's athletic, he can shoot the ball, and he's a big guy in the communication too.
quotes.quote: I would say Donovan Clingan. He's athletic, he can shoot the ball, and he's a big guy in the communication too. He's just a happy guy. I never saw him sad or mad yet. He's every time with a smile and that's the thing we need here on the team.
quotes.social_post: Sidy Cissoko praises Donovan Clingan for his athleticism, shooting ability, and positive attitude, calling him the kind of teammate the Blazers need.

quotes.speaker: Sidy Cissoko
quotes.summary_phrase: Sidy Cissoko on gaining confidence from the coaching staff
quotes.excerpt: Probably just more have more confidence and trust my work. That's why a coach is for.
quotes.quote: Probably just more have more confidence and trust my work. That's it. I feel that's why a coach is for, to give confidence to the player and lead the player too. He's the first one to go to the war every time and we just got to follow his lead.
quotes.social_post: Sidy Cissoko says the coaching staff is helping him build confidence, noting that the coach is the first one to go to war and the players just have to follow his lead.
